title: ever ELYAN|Half Sleeve V-Neck Pleated High Slit A-Line Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a statement at any formal event with this Half Sleeve V-Neck Pleated High Slit A-Line Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress. Whether it's a black tie affair or a glamorous evening gala, this dress is the epitome of chic and glamour. The V-neckline and half sleeves add a touch of modesty, while the high slit adds a hint of allure. The soft, lightweight chiffon fabric flows gracefully with every step, making it a perfect choice for dancing the night away.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
